title: Direct transfers from warehouse-enabled locations in Business Central 2026 wave 2
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 enables direct transfers to work with warehouse-enabled source locations by supporting outbound warehouse handling and allowing posting method configuration per transfer route instead of company-wide only.
key_points: Direct transfers now support outbound warehouse handling (Require Pick, Require Shipment, Bin Mandatory, and Directed Put-away and Pick) at the source location
Two posting methods exist: Direct Transfer (one Posted Direct Transfer document with 2 item ledger entries) and Shipment and Receipt (separate shipment and receipt with 4 item ledger entries)
Posting method can be set at company-wide default level (Inventory Setup) or overridden per transfer route (Transfer Routes page)
Completion workflow depends on source location's warehouse configuration; destinations with bins must have valid Transfer-To Bin Code
Direct transfer posting does not create inbound receipts at destination and destination cannot use Directed Put-away and Pick

quotes.text: The transfer order uses the route setting when one exists, and falls back to the Inventory Setup default when it does not.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the hierarchy of posting method configuration that allows flexibility between company-wide defaults and specific transfer routes.

quotes.text: Direct transfer posting does not create inbound warehouse receipts or inventory put-aways.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical limitation that defines the scope of inbound warehouse control and shapes how destinations must be configured.
